chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, who said:
I said to him: Is there zakat upon one who receives zakat? He said: As for one who receives zakat on wealth, then al-fiṭrah is upon him; and there is no fiṭrah upon one who receives al-fiṭrah.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat; the prescribed alms being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةَ: zakat al-fiṭrah; the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.زَكَاةَ الْمَالِ: zakat on wealth; the regular alms due on qualifying property
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: is due upon him; indicates legal obligation
key_terms.قَبِلَ: received; accepted as a recipient of zakat

ai.seo_question: Does a person who receives zakat still have to pay zakat al-fiṭrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal distinction between one who receives zakat on wealth and one who receives zakat al-fiṭrah. The former is still liable for zakat al-fiṭrah, while the latter is not liable for fiṭrah.
